newsitem.title: SYRIA: Palestinian group urges confrontation with Israel.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian group urges confrontation with Israel.

text.p: The radical Palestinian Alliance called on Thursday for confrontation with Israel to stop plans to build Jewish homes in Arab East Jerusalem.

"The Alliance, while warning of the dangers of this aggressive Zionist policy and calling for the widest confrontation, holds the Oslo traitors (Palestinian self-rule Authority) responsible for the loss of Palestine," it said in a statement.
The Damascus-based group also condemned the U.S. veto of a resolution in the United Nations Security Council opposing the Israeli plans and said international criticism was not enough.
It said the U.S. position showed "flagrant bias in favour of the Zionist enemy".
The Alliance, grouping secular and Islamic factions, has claimed responsibility for several suicide bombings in Israel.
